corrections.why: No source we read says this platform is gone. firelookout.com says it was still there in 2000, and Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Lookouts page list it as abandoned.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says still there in 2000; Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Lookouts page say abandoned (1942). These do not contradict each other, so the record reports the last known standing and an unknown current state.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one platform, three short listings, no staffing or access detail beyond the hike-in tag. The brief's gone status has no source behind it, so the proposed correction is unknown. Elevation 8,094 ft is from idahofirelookouts.com. The section/township/range reading of '21N-14E-20' is ours: the Forest Lookouts page carries no label, so the story says 'we read' it. The Forest Service list writes Big Horn Point as 'Sec21 T38N R8E', which fits that reading, but it is a different source and does not confirm the Forest Lookouts code format. No photos found. Current state needs a Payette NF check or a site visit report before the status is changed again.
